event.title: Local Game Harvest 2026
blurbParagraphs: Your neighbors have been making cool stuff, and it is time to play it!
The 4th annual Local Game Harvest is taking over the Historic Broadway Theater for one night of indie games, weird/cool interactive art installations, and pure local creativity.

Whether you game every day or just want a weird, fun way to spend a Saturday night, come hang out, press some buttons, and experience what the local creative community has been building right here in Louisville.
Family-friendly, completely open to everyone, and put on with love by Louisville Makes Games (a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to supporting local developers and artists).
Come through, play some games, bring a friend, and support local art.

lgh.title: MEAT MECH DUNGEON
lgh.creator: TEAM OMEN
lgh.description: A turn-based DRPG / Dungeon Crawler. Made in two weeks for Mech Jam VII and placed as #1 Overall

lgh.title: Salvation
lgh.creator: Iron135
lgh.description: Fight monsters and demons that have taken over the city.

lgh.title: Harvest Havoc!
lgh.creator: Jason Farnsworth
lgh.description: Help the farmer harvest all year round! Use the Arrow Keys (or WASD) to move the farmer and pick up falling produce and avoid falling obstacles like squirrels, sickles, and wasps! Pick up power-ups to help you on your harvesting journey: granting you super speed, gloves to pick up obstacles, or baskets that collect all produce on screen!

lgh.title: Life Life
lgh.creator: Alex Garbus & Friends
lgh.description: The unrealistic life sim for unrealistic lives!

lgh.title: cloud uprising
lgh.creator: natalie skye hill / loungegames
lgh.description: cloud uprising is a precision platformer centered around endless jumps across single use platforms. The game has 16 worlds, each introducing new mechanics/enemies, such as robotic birds with extending beaks, lines with lightning bolts running through them, and a spinning enemy which the player can bounce across but also must avoid the spikes of. It features an entirely crayon-drawn aesthetic, and a story about weather control, as metaphor for the free and open internet. In this game, the scientist Professor Cline invents weather control, pleasing the gods who deliver the weather, but angering their boss, Mr Glacier, who wants to keep his control. The player follows Brennan, the god of rain, as he looks to overthrow his boss, allowing for the use of Prof. Cline’s invention to benefit humanity.

lgh.title: Roll-A-Bout
lgh.creator: MetaJ92
lgh.description: Roll your way to mastering 4 levels by grabbing the 5 gems and tumbling to the goal. Beat your best time!

lgh.title: Hail of Hexes
lgh.creator: Puffin Piling Games
lgh.description: Hail of Hexes is a time survival, Gradius-style cast-em-up, inspired by Vampire Survivors, and other similar games, featuring entirely original hand-drawn art.

lgh.title: Brew Avenue
lgh.creator: Sylnt Studios
lgh.description: High-speed vertical shoot em' up bullet curtain game

lgh.title: Makealotl Music
lgh.creator: Kristen Salas
lgh.description: Makealotl Music is a collection of edutainment web games. Come play with Delia as you make, match and explore musical concepts.

lgh.title: Untitled Pirate Tactics Game
lgh.creator: Keaton Smith, Houston Miller
lgh.description: You command a diverse pirate crew in this Tactics-RPG, interacting with different parts of a ship for a tactical advantage. Units move on a small hex grid, while the ships they operate on occupy a 10x scaled hex grid on top. In this game, the battlefield is always changing!

lgh.title: Angel Clicker
lgh.creator: oldflowerGames
lgh.description: Angel Clicker is a short, relaxed incremental with (optional) rhythm elements. Build quirky buildings, collect divine resources, get attacked by aliens, and... Go on a date?!

lgh.title: GET ROTATED!
lgh.creator: bad taste games
lgh.description: spinny ball with a shooty frog

lgh.title: The Triangle
lgh.creator: Digital Hollow Interactive, LLC
lgh.description: An interactive LED Triangle puzzle-like action game, controlled by a unique controller.

lgh.title: twenty thousand irises
lgh.creator: fufroom
lgh.description: It is estimated that 20,000 Palestinian children have lost their lives in the conflict since 2023. Many remain unrecovered by their loved ones and are believed to still be under collapsed concrete rubble. Attendees of the event may press a single button to place a Faqqua Iris, the national flower of Palestine, in the scene to collectively create a tribute to the lost children and take a moment to reflect.

lgh.title: The Magic Bookstore
lgh.creator: Dream Distillery Games
lgh.description: The Magic Bookstore is a cozy game, like Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing, but you play as a witch managing a bookstore and discovering magical secrets!

lgh.title: The End of Fall
lgh.creator: Glenn Essex
lgh.description: A short game poem about the onset of winter.
